why: Pins the WIRING of issue #371's idle search, not searchAim itself. search.test.ts can pass in full while the dispatcher never calls it, which is exactly the shipped state before #371 -- every personality passes tank.turretAngle through and the gun sits still. Reverting to that pass-through must not be silent. One failure, not two: with no search the turret is perfectly still, so the anti-jitter case beside it counts zero reversals and still passes. The dormant-gun case is what carries this. Anchor moved by issue #372: the aim chain became three-way (solution, then remembered contact, then search), so the one-line ternary this entry was written against no longer exists. The mutation is unchanged in kind -- it removes SEARCH from the fallback and restores the pass-through -- and now sits on the arm #371 still owns.
killedBy: stepAi turret slew SEARCHES rather than holding the last angle when it has no line of sight (issue #371)
